丝毫.zh: 比赛输了，可他的脸上看不出丝毫失望。
丝毫.en: They lost the match, yet his face showed not the slightest disappointment.

包含.zh: 他的这句话里包含着对孩子深深的爱。
包含.en: His words carried a deep love for his child.

过敏.zh: 这种药可能会引起皮肤过敏，用之前要问医生。
过敏.en: This medicine may cause a skin allergy; ask a doctor before using it.

电台.zh: 这位主持人在广播电台工作了二十年。
电台.en: This host has worked at the radio station for twenty years.

总理.zh: 电视里正在播放总理的新年讲话。
总理.en: The TV is broadcasting the premier's New Year speech.

骨头.zh: 小狗趴在门口，高兴地啃着一块骨头。
骨头.en: The puppy lay at the door, happily gnawing on a bone.

集合.zh: 导游说参观结束后，大家在大巴车旁边集合。
集合.en: The guide said that after the visit everyone should gather beside the coach.

宝贵.zh: 这次比赛给我们积累了宝贵的经验。
宝贵.en: This competition gave us valuable experience.

睁.zh: 医生让他睁开眼睛，看看灯光。
睁.en: The doctor asked him to open his eyes and look at the light.

进口.zh: 这家超市卖很多进口食品，价格比较贵。
进口.en: This supermarket sells a lot of imported food, which is rather expensive.

工程师.zh: 这座大桥是由一位年轻的工程师设计的。
工程师.en: This bridge was designed by a young engineer.

土豆.zh: 晚饭我做了一盘土豆炖牛肉。
土豆.en: For dinner I made a plate of beef stewed with potatoes.

展览.zh: 下个月美术馆要展览几位年轻画家的作品。
展览.en: Next month the art gallery will exhibit works by several young painters.

完善.zh: 这个软件的功能还不够完善，用户提了很多意见。
完善.en: The app's features are not yet well developed, and users have raised many complaints.

猴子.zh: 这只猴子很聪明，会自己剥香蕉皮吃。
猴子.en: This monkey is clever; it can peel a banana by itself.

参考.zh: 这道题的答案仅供参考，不一定完全正确。
参考.en: The answer to this question is for reference only and may not be entirely correct.

拦.zh: 他想闯红灯，被警察拦了下来。
拦.en: He tried to run the red light but was stopped by the police.

志愿者.zh: 图书馆每周六都需要志愿者帮忙整理图书。
志愿者.en: The library needs volunteers every Saturday to help sort the books.

重量.zh: 这辆小车能承受的最大重量是五百公斤。
重量.en: The maximum weight this cart can carry is 500 kilograms.

缓解.zh: 吃了这种药以后，他的头疼得到了缓解。
缓解.en: After taking this medicine, his headache was relieved.

多余.zh: 搬家前，她把多余的家具都送给了邻居。
多余.en: Before moving, she gave her surplus furniture to the neighbours.

发达.zh: 沿海城市经济比较发达，工作机会也更多。
发达.en: Coastal cities are more economically developed and have more job opportunities.

自私.zh: 只想着自己的利益，这种自私的做法让同事们很失望。
自私.en: Thinking only of his own interests, this selfish behaviour disappointed his colleagues.

爱心.zh: 很多人献出爱心，为生病的小女孩捐了款。
爱心.en: Many people showed their kindness and donated money to the sick little girl.

商务.zh: 这家酒店主要接待来出差的商务客人。
商务.en: This hotel mainly serves business guests on work trips.

撕.zh: 她看完信，生气地把它撕成了碎片。
撕.en: After reading the letter, she angrily tore it to pieces.

天真.zh: 小女孩天真地问妈妈，月亮为什么会跟着我们走。
天真.en: The little girl innocently asked her mother why the moon follows us.

沙漠.zh: 骆驼能在沙漠里好几天不喝水。
沙漠.en: Camels can go several days without water in the desert.

语气.zh: 他用开玩笑的语气说出了自己的真实想法。
语气.en: He spoke his real thoughts in a joking tone.

形状.zh: 天上的云不停地变化，形状像一只大白兔。
形状.en: The clouds kept changing; their shape looked like a big white rabbit.

披.zh: 下雨了，他披上雨衣就出门了。
披.en: It started raining, so he threw on a raincoat and went out.

了不起.zh: 这位老人七十岁还学会了用电脑，真是了不起！
了不起.en: This old man learned to use a computer at seventy—truly amazing!

证件.zh: 我的钱包丢了，里面的证件也都没有了。
证件.en: I lost my wallet, and all the ID papers in it are gone too.

幼儿园.zh: 女儿今年三岁，九月就要上幼儿园了。
幼儿园.en: My daughter is three this year and will start kindergarten in September.

影子.zh: 晚上路灯一照，地上就出现了我们的影子。
影子.en: When the street lamps shine at night, our shadows appear on the ground.

延长.zh: 考试期间，图书馆把开放时间延长到晚上十一点。
延长.en: During exams, the library extends its opening hours to 11 p.m.

地道.zh: 这家小饭馆做的是地道的四川菜。
地道.en: This little restaurant serves authentic Sichuan food.

数码.zh: 数码时代，很多人已经不再去照相馆洗照片了。
数码.en: In the digital age, many people no longer go to photo studios to print photos.

实习.zh: 医学院的学生最后一年要在医院实习。
实习.en: Medical students must do an internship at a hospital in their final year.

盆.zh: 阳台上那盆花好几天没浇水，叶子都黄了。
盆.en: The pot of flowers on the balcony hasn't been watered for days, and its leaves have turned yellow.

性质.zh: 这次事故的性质非常严重，必须认真调查。
性质.en: The nature of this accident is very serious and must be investigated carefully.

神话.zh: 这部电影是根据一个古老的神话改编的。
神话.en: This film is adapted from an ancient myth.

紫.zh: 秋天到了，葡萄都变成了深紫色。
紫.en: Autumn has come, and the grapes have all turned deep purple.

称呼.zh: 在中国，学生一般称呼老师为“王老师”“李老师”。
称呼.en: In China, students usually address teachers as "Teacher Wang" or "Teacher Li".

推广.zh: 这家公司正在网上推广他们的新产品。
推广.en: This company is promoting its new product online.

营业.zh: 春节期间，这家银行只营业半天。
营业.en: During the Spring Festival, this bank is open for only half a day.

古代.zh: 在古代，人们写信要花好几个月才能送到。
古代.en: In ancient times, a letter took several months to arrive.

问候.zh: 老同学见面，先互相问候了几句。
问候.en: When the old classmates met, they first exchanged a few greetings.

铃.zh: 我正在洗澡，门铃突然响了。
铃.en: I was taking a shower when the doorbell suddenly rang.

农业.zh: 这个国家大量使用机器来发展现代农业。
农业.en: This country makes wide use of machines to develop modern agriculture.

洒.zh: 夏天的早上，工人们在街上洒水降温。
洒.en: On summer mornings, workers spray water on the streets to cool them down.

纪律.zh: 这个班的课堂纪律很好，上课时没人说话。
纪律.en: This class has good discipline; nobody talks during lessons.

面积.zh: 这个湖的面积相当于十个足球场那么大。
面积.en: The area of this lake is equal to about ten football pitches.

闪电.zh: 小狗一看到闪电、听到雷声，就躲到床底下。
闪电.en: As soon as the puppy sees lightning and hears thunder, it hides under the bed.

桃.zh: 春天，山上的桃花都开了，粉红一片。
桃.en: In spring, the peach blossoms on the hill are all out, a sea of pink.

广泛.zh: 这种新技术已经被广泛应用在医疗领域。
广泛.en: This new technology is already widely used in medicine.

手套.zh: 洗碗的时候，她总是戴上橡胶手套保护双手。
手套.en: When washing dishes, she always puts on rubber gloves to protect her hands.

讽刺.zh: 这部喜剧用幽默的方式讽刺了社会上的浪费现象。
讽刺.en: This comedy uses humour to satirize wastefulness in society.

悄悄.zh: 妈妈悄悄地在女儿的书包里放了一张生日卡。
悄悄.en: Mum secretly slipped a birthday card into her daughter's schoolbag.

差距.zh: 虽然我进步了很多，但是和第一名还有很大的差距。
差距.en: Although I've improved a lot, there's still a big gap between me and the top student.

总共.zh: 我们班总共有三十八个学生。
总共.en: Our class has thirty-eight students in total.

粮食.zh: 今年雨水充足，粮食获得了大丰收。
粮食.en: There was plenty of rain this year, and the grain crop had a bumper harvest.

糊涂.zh: 爷爷年纪大了，有时候会变得有点儿糊涂。
糊涂.en: Grandpa is getting old and sometimes becomes a little muddled.

豆腐.zh: 麻婆豆腐是一道很有名的四川菜。
豆腐.en: Mapo tofu is a very famous Sichuan dish.

促进.zh: 多交流可以促进同学之间的了解。
促进.en: Communicating more can promote understanding between classmates.

何必.zh: 既然已经决定了，你又何必再后悔呢？
何必.en: Since you've already decided, why bother regretting it?

优惠.zh: 学生凭学生证买门票可以享受半价优惠。
优惠.en: Students can get a half-price discount on tickets with their student card.

恶劣.zh: 工厂的工作环境非常恶劣，很多工人都辞职了。
恶劣.en: Working conditions at the factory were terrible, and many workers quit.

字母.zh: 请用大写字母填写你的姓名。
字母.en: Please fill in your name in capital letters.

高档.zh: 这条街上开了很多高档服装店。
高档.en: Many high-end clothing shops have opened on this street.

废话.zh: 他开会时说了半天废话，一句重点都没有。
废话.en: He talked rubbish for ages at the meeting without making a single key point.

个别.zh: 这只是个别现象，大部分顾客都很满意。
个别.en: This is just an isolated case; most customers are very satisfied.

蝴蝶.zh: 毛毛虫经过一段时间以后会变成美丽的蝴蝶。
蝴蝶.en: After a while, a caterpillar turns into a beautiful butterfly.

利息.zh: 他向银行借了一笔钱，每个月都要还利息。
利息.en: He borrowed money from the bank and has to pay interest every month.

否定.zh: 对于记者的问题，他给出了否定的回答。
否定.en: He gave a negative answer to the reporter's question.

灵活.zh: 小猫的动作非常灵活，一下子就跳上了柜子。
灵活.en: The kitten is very nimble and leapt onto the cabinet in one go.

主张.zh: 这位专家主张孩子应该多到户外活动。
主张.en: This expert advocates that children should spend more time outdoors.

辣椒.zh: 我不太能吃辣，请别在菜里放辣椒。
辣椒.en: I can't handle spicy food; please don't put chilli in the dish.

嫩.zh: 春天刚长出来的叶子又绿又嫩。
嫩.en: The leaves that have just come out in spring are green and tender.

沙滩.zh: 夏天的傍晚，很多人光着脚在沙滩上散步。
沙滩.en: On summer evenings, many people walk barefoot on the beach.

亲切.zh: 回到家乡，听到熟悉的口音，我感到特别亲切。
亲切.en: Back in my hometown, hearing the familiar accent felt especially warm.

预订.zh: 国庆节去旅游的人很多，最好提前预订机票。
预订.en: Lots of people travel over National Day, so it's best to book flights in advance.

地毯.zh: 孩子们喜欢坐在软软的地毯上玩积木。
地毯.en: The children like to sit on the soft carpet and play with building blocks.

办理.zh: 这个窗口只办理信用卡业务。
办理.en: This window only handles credit card business.

趋势.zh: 从数据来看，这家公司的销售额呈上升趋势。
趋势.en: Judging from the data, the company's sales show an upward trend.

艰苦.zh: 他们在山区艰苦奋斗了十年，终于修好了这条路。
艰苦.en: They struggled hard in the mountains for ten years and finally built this road.

钢铁.zh: 这座城市以前是有名的钢铁工业中心。
钢铁.en: This city used to be a famous centre of the steel industry.

名牌.zh: 他从一所名牌大学毕业，很快就找到了工作。
名牌.en: He graduated from a prestigious university and quickly found a job.

鼓掌.zh: 小明回答对了问题，同学们都为他鼓掌。
鼓掌.en: Xiaoming answered the question correctly, and his classmates all applauded him.

学术.zh: 下周有一个国际学术会议在我们学校召开。
学术.en: Next week an international academic conference will be held at our university.

原料.zh: 由于原料价格上涨，工厂的成本提高了不少。
原料.en: Because raw material prices rose, the factory's costs went up considerably.

透明.zh: 公司的财务应该公开透明，让员工放心。
透明.en: A company's finances should be open and transparent so that staff can feel at ease.

地理.zh: 这个城市的地理位置很好，交通非常方便。
地理.en: This city has a good geographical location, and transport is very convenient.

翅膀.zh: 这只小鸟的翅膀受伤了，暂时飞不起来。
翅膀.en: This bird's wing is hurt, so it can't fly for the time being.

阳台.zh: 天气好的时候，我喜欢把衣服挂在阳台上晒。
阳台.en: When the weather is nice, I like to hang the clothes out on the balcony to dry.

项链.zh: 她脖子上戴着一条闪闪发光的珍珠项链。
项链.en: She is wearing a shining pearl necklace around her neck.

鼓舞.zh: 教练的一番话鼓舞了全体队员的士气。
鼓舞.en: The coach's words boosted the morale of the whole team.

抄.zh: 老师让我们把黑板上的生词抄在本子上。
抄.en: The teacher told us to copy the new words on the blackboard into our notebooks.

佩服.zh: 她一边工作一边读完了博士，大家都很佩服她。
佩服.en: She finished her PhD while working, and everyone admires her.

妨碍.zh: 你把车停在门口，会妨碍别人进出。
妨碍.en: If you park at the door, you'll get in the way of people going in and out.

名片.zh: 见面时，他双手递给我一张名片。
名片.en: When we met, he handed me a business card with both hands.

花生.zh: 每年秋天，奶奶都要去地里收花生。
花生.en: Every autumn, Grandma goes to the field to harvest peanuts.

迟早.zh: 这个秘密迟早会被大家发现的。
迟早.en: This secret will be discovered by everyone sooner or later.

宴会.zh: 结婚那天，他们在酒店举办了一场盛大的宴会。
宴会.en: On their wedding day, they held a grand banquet at a hotel.

岸.zh: 船慢慢靠岸，乘客们开始下船。
岸.en: The boat slowly came to shore, and the passengers began to get off.

尾巴.zh: 孔雀的尾巴打开时像一把美丽的扇子。
尾巴.en: When a peacock spreads its tail, it looks like a beautiful fan.

随身.zh: 这个包很小，正好可以装些随身物品。
随身.en: This bag is small, just right for carrying a few personal belongings.

罚款.zh: 他开车超速，被交警罚款两百元。
罚款.en: He was speeding and was fined 200 yuan by the traffic police.

握手.zh: 比赛开始前，两位选手友好地握手。
握手.en: Before the match began, the two players shook hands in a friendly way.

手工.zh: 她喜欢做手工，送给朋友的礼物都是自己做的。
手工.en: She enjoys handicrafts; the gifts she gives her friends are all homemade.

歇.zh: 你忙了一整天了，快去床上歇着吧。
歇.en: You've been busy all day; go and lie down for a rest.

勿.zh: 博物馆里的展品请勿用手触摸。
勿.en: Please do not touch the exhibits in the museum.

题目.zh: 这次考试的题目太难了，很多同学没做完。
题目.en: The questions in this exam were too hard, and many students didn't finish.

节省.zh: 为了节省用电，离开房间时要关掉空调。
节省.en: To save electricity, turn off the air conditioner when you leave the room.

围巾.zh: 妈妈给我织了一条红色的毛线围巾。
围巾.en: Mum knitted me a red woollen scarf.

何况.zh: 平时开车都要两个小时，何况今天还下大雪。
何况.en: The drive normally takes two hours, let alone today with heavy snow.

删除.zh: 这些照片太多了，我想删除一些不清楚的。
删除.en: There are too many photos; I want to delete some of the blurry ones.

车厢.zh: 这列火车一共有十六节车厢。
车厢.en: This train has sixteen carriages in total.

失眠.zh: 喝太多咖啡容易导致失眠。
失眠.en: Drinking too much coffee can easily lead to insomnia.

绳子.zh: 她在两棵树之间拉了一根绳子，用来晒衣服。
绳子.en: She strung a rope between two trees to dry clothes on.

优美.zh: 她的舞姿非常优美，赢得了观众的喜爱。
优美.en: Her dancing is very graceful and won the audience's affection.

传染.zh: 这种病不会传染，你不用担心。
传染.en: This illness isn't contagious, so you needn't worry.

分布.zh: 我国人口分布不均匀，东部多，西部少。
分布.en: Our country's population is unevenly distributed: more in the east, fewer in the west.

流泪.zh: 切洋葱的时候，我总是忍不住流泪。
流泪.en: When I chop onions, I can never stop my eyes from watering.

递.zh: 吃饭的时候，他把盐递给了坐在对面的客人。
递.en: During the meal, he passed the salt to the guest sitting opposite.

胃口.zh: 看到满桌子的好菜，大家胃口大开。
胃口.en: Seeing a table full of delicious dishes, everyone's appetite was whetted.

赞美.zh: 听到别人的赞美，她害羞得脸都红了。
赞美.en: Hearing other people's praise, she blushed with shyness.

痒.zh: 这件毛衣穿在身上有点儿痒，我想换一件。
痒.en: This sweater feels a bit itchy on me; I want to change it.

疲劳.zh: 长时间看电脑容易造成眼睛疲劳。
疲劳.en: Looking at a computer for a long time easily causes eye fatigue.

台阶.zh: 他说错了话，幸好朋友给了他一个台阶下。
台阶.en: He said the wrong thing, but luckily a friend gave him a way out.

目录.zh: 这个网站的商品目录分得很清楚，找东西很方便。
目录.en: This website's product catalogue is clearly organised, so it's easy to find things.

耽误.zh: 别因为玩游戏耽误了学习。
耽误.en: Don't let gaming hold up your studies.

彩虹.zh: 瀑布旁边的水雾里常常能看到一道彩虹。
彩虹.en: A rainbow can often be seen in the mist beside the waterfall.

柜台.zh: 在商场的化妆品柜台，她试了好几种口红。
柜台.en: At the department store's cosmetics counter, she tried several lipsticks.

打听.zh: 他到处打听那位老同学的消息。
打听.en: He asked around everywhere for news of that old classmate.

促使.zh: 一场大病促使他下决心戒烟。
促使.en: A serious illness prompted him to resolve to quit smoking.

钓.zh: 湖边坐着几个老人，正安静地钓着鱼。
钓.en: Several old men sat by the lake, quietly fishing.

辩论.zh: 我们班在学校的辩论比赛中得了第一名。
辩论.en: Our class won first place in the school debate competition.

怪不得.zh: 外面下雪了，怪不得这么冷。
怪不得.en: It's snowing outside—no wonder it's so cold.

种类.zh: 超市里牛奶的种类太多了，我不知道该买哪种。
种类.en: There are so many kinds of milk in the supermarket that I don't know which to buy.

老百姓.zh: 这条新修的公路给当地老百姓带来了很多方便。
老百姓.en: The newly built road has brought great convenience to the local people.

辅导.zh: 考试前，王老师每天放学后给我们辅导数学。
辅导.en: Before the exam, Teacher Wang tutored us in maths every day after school.

未必.zh: 他说明天会来，可是我觉得他未必有时间。
未必.en: He said he'd come tomorrow, but I don't think he'll necessarily have time.

牛仔裤.zh: 这条牛仔裤洗了几次以后颜色变浅了。
牛仔裤.en: These jeans faded after being washed a few times.

浏览.zh: 这个网站每天的浏览量超过一百万次。
浏览.en: This website gets over a million page views a day.

古典.zh: 这座城市有很多古典风格的建筑。
古典.en: This city has many buildings in the classical style.

大方.zh: 她穿得简单大方，给面试官留下了好印象。
大方.en: She dressed simply and tastefully, leaving a good impression on the interviewer.

斜.zh: 这棵树长得有点儿斜，好像快要倒了。
斜.en: This tree is growing at a slant, as if it's about to fall over.

启发.zh: 这部电影启发我重新思考人生的意义。
启发.en: This film inspired me to rethink the meaning of life.

体贴.zh: 女儿很体贴，知道我累了就主动给我倒茶。
体贴.en: My daughter is very thoughtful; when she sees I'm tired, she pours me tea without being asked.

壶.zh: 客人来了，奶奶赶紧泡了一壶绿茶。
壶.en: When the guests arrived, Grandma quickly made a pot of green tea.

浇.zh: 他刚出门就被大雨浇得全身湿透了。
浇.en: As soon as he went out, the downpour drenched him to the skin.

生动.zh: 这位老师讲课非常生动，学生们都爱听。
生动.en: This teacher lectures very vividly, and the students love listening to him.

步骤.zh: 做这道菜一共有五个步骤，第一步是洗菜。
步骤.en: Making this dish takes five steps; the first is washing the vegetables.

乙.zh: 这次比赛，我们班被分在乙组。
乙.en: In this competition, our class was placed in Group B.

梨.zh: 秋天天气干燥，多吃梨对嗓子好。
梨.en: Autumn weather is dry, and eating more pears is good for your throat.

人事.zh: 新员工入职的材料要交到人事处。
人事.en: New employees must hand in their onboarding documents to the personnel office.

热心.zh: 这位司机很热心，下车后还把我们送到了门口。
热心.en: The driver was very warm-hearted; after we got out, he even walked us to the door.

纷纷.zh: 秋风一吹，树叶纷纷落了下来。
纷纷.en: When the autumn wind blew, the leaves fell one after another.

出示.zh: 进入考场时，考生需要出示准考证。
出示.en: On entering the exam hall, candidates must show their admission ticket.

单元.zh: 我家住在三号楼二单元五楼。
单元.en: My home is on the fifth floor of entrance 2, building 3.

吸取.zh: 植物通过根从土壤里吸取水分。
吸取.en: Plants absorb water from the soil through their roots.

流传.zh: 这首民歌已经流传了很多年，大人孩子都会唱。
流传.en: This folk song has been handed down for many years; adults and children alike can sing it.

海关.zh: 这些药品必须向海关申报才能带入国内。
海关.en: These medicines must be declared to customs before they can be brought into the country.

消极.zh: 他工作态度很消极，总是能少做就少做。
消极.en: His attitude to work is very passive; he always does as little as he can.

简历.zh: 写简历的时候，要突出自己的优点和经验。
简历.en: When writing a CV, you should highlight your strengths and experience.

自觉.zh: 排队的时候，大家都很自觉，没有人插队。
自觉.en: Everyone queued conscientiously; nobody cut in line.

醋.zh: 看到男朋友跟别的女孩聊天，她有点儿吃醋。
醋.en: Seeing her boyfriend chatting with another girl, she got a little jealous.

摔倒.zh: 小孩子学走路的时候，经常会摔倒。
摔倒.en: When toddlers are learning to walk, they often fall down.

夸.zh: 邻居们都夸这个小姑娘懂事又有礼貌。
夸.en: The neighbours all praise this little girl for being sensible and polite.

干燥.zh: 饼干要放在干燥的地方，不然容易变软。
干燥.en: Biscuits should be kept in a dry place, or they'll go soft.

嗓子.zh: 那位歌手的嗓子很好，唱高音一点儿也不费力。
嗓子.en: That singer has a great voice; high notes cost him no effort at all.

专心.zh: 他正在专心地画画，连妈妈叫他都没听见。
专心.en: He was concentrating so hard on drawing that he didn't even hear his mum call him.

中介.zh: 通过中介找工作，一般要付一笔服务费。
中介.en: Finding a job through an agency usually means paying a service fee.

看望.zh: 我出差路过老家，顺便看望了一下以前的老师。
看望.en: Passing through my hometown on a business trip, I dropped in to visit my old teacher.

征求.zh: 搬家之前，他先征求了父母的同意。
征求.en: Before moving, he first sought his parents' consent.

救护车.zh: 救护车很快就到了，把老人送进了医院。
救护车.en: The ambulance soon arrived and took the old man to hospital.

键盘.zh: 他打字的时候不用看键盘。
键盘.en: He doesn't need to look at the keyboard when he types.

蜜蜂.zh: 那只蜜蜂在我耳边嗡嗡地飞了半天。
蜜蜂.en: That bee buzzed around my ear for ages.

实用.zh: 这个包虽然不好看，但是很实用。
实用.en: This bag isn't pretty, but it's very practical.

繁荣.zh: 改革开放以后，这个小渔村变得繁荣起来。
繁荣.en: After reform and opening up, this little fishing village became prosperous.

册.zh: 图书馆新买了两千册图书。
册.en: The library has just bought two thousand volumes of books.

被子.zh: 今天阳光很好，妈妈把被子拿出去晒了。
被子.en: It's sunny today, so Mum took the quilts out to air in the sun.

车库.zh: 这个小区的地下车库有五百个车位。
车库.en: This housing estate's underground garage has five hundred parking spaces.

宁可.zh: 他宁可走路去，也不愿意坐那辆又脏又挤的公交车。
宁可.en: He'd rather walk than take that dirty, crowded bus.

报社.zh: 他把自己写的文章寄给了一家报社。
报社.en: He sent the article he had written to a newspaper.

农村.zh: 很多农村的年轻人到大城市打工。
农村.en: Many young people from the countryside go to work in big cities.

迫切.zh: 这个地区的孩子迫切需要一所新学校。
迫切.en: The children in this area urgently need a new school.

打交道.zh: 他是一个程序员，每天主要跟电脑打交道。
打交道.en: He's a programmer and mostly deals with computers every day.

用途.zh: 这把小刀有很多用途，还可以用来开瓶子。
用途.en: This little knife has many uses; it can even open bottles.

兼职.zh: 她白天上班，晚上还在一家咖啡店兼职。
兼职.en: She works during the day and also has a part-time job at a café in the evenings.

零件.zh: 这辆旧自行车的零件已经很难买到了。
零件.en: Parts for this old bicycle are now hard to find.

难免.zh: 两个人生活在一起，难免会有一些小矛盾。
难免.en: When two people live together, a few small conflicts are bound to happen.

招待.zh: 朋友来家里做客，我做了一桌好菜招待他们。
招待.en: When friends came to visit, I cooked a table full of good dishes to entertain them.

称赞.zh: 这家餐厅的服务受到了顾客的一致称赞。
称赞.en: This restaurant's service has been unanimously praised by its customers.

不得了.zh: 不得了，厨房里冒烟了，快去看看！
不得了.en: Oh no, there's smoke in the kitchen—go and look, quick!

时髦.zh: 她奶奶七十岁了，还喜欢穿时髦的衣服。
时髦.en: Her grandma is seventy and still likes to wear fashionable clothes.

拥挤.zh: 节假日的时候，景点里总是很拥挤。
拥挤.en: On public holidays, tourist sites are always crowded.

预报.zh: 气象台预报说，台风今晚会经过本市。
预报.en: The weather bureau forecasts that a typhoon will pass through the city tonight.

支票.zh: 他开了一张一万元的支票给我。
支票.en: He wrote me a cheque for ten thousand yuan.

窄.zh: 这件衬衫的袖子太窄了，我穿不进去。
窄.en: The sleeves of this shirt are too narrow; I can't get my arms in.

点心.zh: 这家茶楼的广式点心非常有名。
点心.en: This teahouse's Cantonese dim sum is very famous.

着火.zh: 那片森林着火了，烟很远都能看见。
着火.en: That forest caught fire, and the smoke could be seen from far away.

光临.zh: 感谢您的光临，欢迎下次再来！
光临.en: Thank you for your visit; please come again!

逐步.zh: 公司计划在三年内逐步扩大生产规模。
逐步.en: The company plans to expand production step by step over three years.

整齐.zh: 运动员们穿着整齐的服装走进了体育场。
整齐.en: The athletes marched into the stadium in neat uniforms.

常识.zh: 小孩子应该学一些安全常识，比如不跟陌生人走。
常识.en: Children should learn some basic safety knowledge, such as not going off with strangers.

可见.zh: 这么多人排队买他的新书，可见他有多受欢迎。
可见.en: So many people are queuing to buy his new book—it shows how popular he is.

无奈.zh: 我很想去，无奈工作太忙，实在走不开。
无奈.en: I'd love to go, but unfortunately work is too busy and I really can't get away.

小麦.zh: 我们平时吃的面粉，大多是用小麦磨成的。
小麦.en: Most of the flour we eat every day is ground from wheat.

木头.zh: 地上有一根木头，小心别绊倒。
木头.en: There's a log on the ground; be careful not to trip over it.

格外.zh: 今天是她的生日，她打扮得格外漂亮。
格外.en: It's her birthday today, and she's dressed up especially beautifully.

大象.zh: 大象是陆地上最大的动物。
大象.en: The elephant is the largest animal on land.

讲座.zh: 这位作家下周会来我们大学开一个讲座。
讲座.en: This writer will come to our university to give a lecture next week.

印刷.zh: 这本杂志每月印刷五万份。
印刷.en: This magazine prints fifty thousand copies a month.

英俊.zh: 照片上那个英俊的小伙子就是年轻时候的爷爷。
英俊.en: The handsome young man in the photo is Grandpa when he was young.

舍不得.zh: 这件衣服太贵了，她看了半天还是舍不得买。
舍不得.en: This dress is too expensive; she looked at it for ages but couldn't bring herself to buy it.

日程.zh: 总经理的日程已经排到下个月了。
日程.en: The general manager's schedule is already booked into next month.

报到.zh: 他明天第一天上班，要早点儿去公司报到。
报到.en: Tomorrow is his first day at work, and he has to report to the company early.

零食.zh: 孩子们看电影的时候总要买很多零食。
零食.en: Children always buy lots of snacks when they go to the cinema.

因而.zh: 这种手机价格便宜，质量也不错，因而很受学生欢迎。
因而.en: This phone is cheap and of decent quality, and is therefore popular with students.

巧妙.zh: 设计师巧妙地利用了墙角，多出了一个书架的空间。
巧妙.en: The designer cleverly made use of the corner, creating room for a bookshelf.

眉毛.zh: 她每天出门前都要化妆，画一下眉毛。
眉毛.en: Every day before going out, she puts on make-up and draws her eyebrows.

学历.zh: 现在很多公司除了看学历，更看重工作能力。
学历.en: Nowadays many companies look beyond educational background and value work ability more.

痛快.zh: 他答应得很痛快，一点儿也没犹豫。
痛快.en: He agreed readily, without the slightest hesitation.

美术.zh: 下午第二节是美术课，我们要画一幅风景画。
美术.en: The second lesson this afternoon is art; we're going to paint a landscape.

家务.zh: 结婚以后，他们两个人一起分担家务。
家务.en: Since getting married, the two of them have shared the housework.

海鲜.zh: 他每次去海边都要吃一顿海鲜大餐。
海鲜.en: Every time he goes to the seaside, he has a big seafood feast.

描写.zh: 这篇作文对人物的心理描写非常细致。
描写.en: This essay's description of the characters' inner thoughts is very detailed.

窗帘.zh: 新家的窗帘是浅蓝色的，看起来很舒服。
窗帘.en: The curtains in the new home are light blue and look very pleasant.

武术.zh: 他从五岁开始练武术，现在是全国冠军。
武术.en: He started practising martial arts at five and is now national champion.

开幕式.zh: 奥运会开幕式的表演让全世界的观众印象深刻。
开幕式.en: The performance at the Olympic opening ceremony impressed audiences around the world.

熬夜.zh: 为了准备考试，他昨天熬夜到凌晨三点。
熬夜.en: To prepare for the exam, he stayed up until three in the morning last night.

舅舅.zh: 妈妈的哥哥要来我们家住，我好久没见到舅舅了。
舅舅.en: Mum's elder brother is coming to stay with us; I haven't seen my uncle for ages.

主观.zh: 判断一件事情的对错，不能只凭主观感觉。
主观.en: When judging whether something is right or wrong, you can't rely only on subjective feelings.

缩短.zh: 为了提高效率，公司把每次开会的时间缩短到半小时。
缩短.en: To improve efficiency, the company cut every meeting to half an hour.

乐器.zh: 钢琴常常被人们称为“乐器之王”。
乐器.en: The piano is often called "the king of instruments".

长途.zh: 他是一名卡车司机，常年在外面跑长途。
长途.en: He's a lorry driver who spends the whole year on long-haul routes.

广大.zh: 这部电视剧受到了广大观众的喜爱。
广大.en: This TV series is loved by viewers everywhere.

剪刀.zh: 理发师拿起剪刀，开始给我剪头发。
剪刀.en: The barber picked up the scissors and started cutting my hair.

合影.zh: 旅行结束前，大家在长城上拍了一张合影。
合影.en: Before the trip ended, everyone took a group photo on the Great Wall.

议论.zh: 别在背后议论别人，这样很不礼貌。
议论.en: Don't talk about people behind their backs; it's very rude.

当心.zh: 当心！地上有水，别滑倒了。
当心.en: Careful! There's water on the floor—don't slip.

操心.zh: 妈妈总是为家里的大小事情操心。
操心.en: Mum is always worrying about every family matter, big and small.

熟练.zh: 这位厨师切菜的动作非常熟练。
熟练.en: This chef chops vegetables very skilfully.

上当.zh: 我花三百块买了一个假包，真是上当了。
上当.en: I paid three hundred yuan for a fake bag—I was really taken in.

过期.zh: 我的护照下个月就要过期了，得赶紧去办新的。
过期.en: My passport expires next month, so I need to get a new one quickly.

及格.zh: 这门课考六十分以上才算及格。
及格.en: In this course you need over sixty points to pass.

谦虚.zh: 他总说自己做得不好，其实是太谦虚了。
谦虚.en: He always says he didn't do well, but really he's just being too modest.

讲究.zh: 他穿衣服很讲究，每天都要搭配好颜色。
讲究.en: He's particular about his clothes and matches the colours every day.

测验.zh: 每个单元学完以后，我们都有一次小测验。
测验.en: After each unit, we have a short quiz.

发票.zh: 出差回来以后，要拿发票去公司报销。
发票.en: After a business trip, you take the invoices to the company to be reimbursed.

抽屉.zh: 他把那封信锁在了书桌的抽屉里。
抽屉.en: He locked that letter in the desk drawer.

词汇.zh: 这本书的词汇难度适合中级学生。
词汇.en: The vocabulary level of this book suits intermediate students.

叙述.zh: 这篇小说用第一人称叙述了一个孩子的成长。
叙述.en: This novel narrates a child's growing up in the first person.

粗糙.zh: 奶奶干了一辈子农活，手变得很粗糙。
粗糙.en: Grandma did farm work all her life, and her hands became very rough.

傍晚.zh: 傍晚的时候，天边的云变成了红色。
傍晚.en: At dusk, the clouds on the horizon turned red.

胡说.zh: 他根本没去过那儿，完全是在胡说。
胡说.en: He's never been there at all; he's talking complete nonsense.

匆忙.zh: 这次旅行太匆忙了，很多地方都没来得及去。
匆忙.en: This trip was too rushed; we didn't have time to visit many places.

不要紧.zh: 你要是今天没空，不要紧，我们改天再见。
不要紧.en: If you're not free today, it doesn't matter; we can meet another day.

狡猾.zh: 那个骗子很狡猾，换了好几个名字。
狡猾.en: That swindler was very crafty and changed his name several times.

一再.zh: 他一再向我保证，以后不会再迟到了。
一再.en: He repeatedly promised me that he would never be late again.

行人.zh: 这条街只允许行人通过，车辆不能进入。
行人.en: This street is open only to pedestrians; vehicles may not enter.

初级.zh: 他通过了初级考试，下个月准备考中级。
初级.en: He passed the elementary exam and is preparing to take the intermediate one next month.

外公.zh: 妈妈小时候，外公常常带她去河边钓鱼。
外公.en: When Mum was little, her father—my grandpa—often took her fishing by the river.

光滑.zh: 这张桌子表面很光滑，像镜子一样。
光滑.en: The surface of this table is very smooth, like a mirror.

发抖.zh: 第一次上台演讲，他紧张得双腿发抖。
发抖.en: Giving his first speech on stage, he was so nervous that his legs trembled.

灰尘.zh: 打开那本旧书，上面全是灰尘。
灰尘.en: When I opened that old book, it was covered in dust.

盼望.zh: 他在外地工作，家人一直盼望他早点儿回来。
盼望.en: He works far from home, and his family has long been hoping he'll come back soon.

轮流.zh: 晚上照顾病人，兄弟姐妹几个人轮流值班。
轮流.en: To look after the patient at night, the brothers and sisters take turns on duty.

硬件.zh: 学校的硬件设施很好，但是老师不够。
硬件.en: The school's physical facilities are good, but there aren't enough teachers.

改正.zh: 知道自己错了，就要马上改正，不要找借口。
改正.en: Once you know you're wrong, correct it right away and don't make excuses.

结实.zh: 他从小练游泳，身体特别结实，很少感冒。
结实.en: He has swum since childhood, so he's very strong and rarely catches colds.

幸亏.zh: 幸亏带了伞，不然就被淋湿了。
幸亏.en: Luckily I brought an umbrella, or I would have got soaked.

爱护.zh: 这些书是公共的，请大家爱护，不要在上面写字。
爱护.en: These books are shared; please take good care of them and don't write in them.

姑姑.zh: 我姑姑是爸爸唯一的姐姐，从小就特别疼我。
姑姑.en: My aunt is Dad's only elder sister, and she has doted on me since I was little.

悲观.zh: 医生说他的病情并不悲观，治好的可能性很大。
悲观.en: The doctor said his condition isn't hopeless; there's a good chance of a cure.

肥皂.zh: 这块肥皂是用天然植物做的，洗衣服很干净。
肥皂.en: This bar of soap is made from natural plants and gets clothes very clean.

委屈.zh: 孩子受了委屈，一回家就哭了起来。
委屈.en: The child had been treated unfairly and burst into tears as soon as he got home.

作文.zh: 她的作文在全市比赛中获得了一等奖。
作文.en: Her essay won first prize in the citywide competition.

本领.zh: 消防员有很多救人的本领。

勤奋.zh: 她靠勤奋，从一名普通员工成为了部门经理。
勤奋.en: Through hard work, she rose from an ordinary employee to department manager.

寿命.zh: 这种电池的使用寿命大约是五年。
寿命.en: The service life of this battery is about five years.

动画片.zh: 这部动画片讲的是一只小熊找妈妈的故事。
动画片.en: This cartoon tells the story of a little bear looking for its mother.

周到.zh: 他考虑问题很周到，每个细节都想到了。
周到.en: He thinks things through very thoroughly and considers every detail.

操场.zh: 早上六点，已经有很多人在操场上跑步了。
操场.en: At six in the morning, lots of people are already running on the sports field.

兑换.zh: 这张会员卡的积分可以兑换礼品。
兑换.en: The points on this membership card can be exchanged for gifts.

酱油.zh: 做红烧肉时要放酱油，颜色才好看。
酱油.en: When making braised pork, you add soy sauce so that the colour looks good.

急诊.zh: 晚上门诊已经下班了，只能去挂急诊。
急诊.en: The outpatient clinic is closed at night, so you can only register at the emergency department.

艰巨.zh: 修建这条海底隧道是一项十分艰巨的工程。
艰巨.en: Building this undersea tunnel is an extremely formidable project.

陆地.zh: 乌龟既能在水里游，也能在陆地上爬。
陆地.en: Turtles can both swim in water and crawl on land.

惭愧.zh: 妈妈每天那么辛苦，我却什么家务都不做，真惭愧。
惭愧.en: Mum works so hard every day, yet I do no housework at all—I'm truly ashamed.

交际.zh: 学好一门外语，可以扩大你的交际范围。
交际.en: Learning a foreign language well can widen your social circle.

字幕.zh: 这部电影没有字幕，我只能听懂一半。
字幕.en: This film has no subtitles, so I can only understand half of it.

振动.zh: 地铁经过的时候，楼里能感觉到轻微的振动。
振动.en: When the underground train passes, you can feel a slight vibration in the building.

感想.zh: 参观完博物馆，老师让我们写一篇感想。
感想.en: After the museum visit, the teacher asked us to write up our impressions.

执照.zh: 开饭馆必须先办好营业执照。
执照.en: To open a restaurant, you must first obtain a business licence.

提倡.zh: 现在社会上提倡节约用水，保护环境。
提倡.en: Society now promotes saving water and protecting the environment.

潮湿.zh: 地下室很潮湿，放在那里的书都发霉了。
潮湿.en: The basement is very damp; the books kept there have all gone mouldy.

香肠.zh: 这种香肠是用猪肉做的，味道有点儿甜。
香肠.en: This sausage is made of pork and tastes a little sweet.

昆虫.zh: 这个博物馆收集了上千种昆虫标本。
昆虫.en: This museum has collected specimens of over a thousand kinds of insects.

概括.zh: 老师让我们用三个词概括自己的性格。
概括.en: The teacher asked us to sum up our personalities in three words.

坦率.zh: 他是个坦率的人，有什么意见都会直接说出来。
坦率.en: He's a frank person who says whatever he thinks directly.

均匀.zh: 把面粉和水搅拌均匀，再放进锅里。
均匀.en: Mix the flour and water evenly, then put it in the pot.

火柴.zh: 小时候，奶奶做饭都是用火柴点火。
火柴.en: When I was little, Grandma always lit the stove with matches.

收据.zh: 退货的时候，必须带上购物收据。
收据.en: When returning goods, you must bring the purchase receipt.

耳环.zh: 她刚打了耳洞，还不能戴太重的耳环。
耳环.en: She's just had her ears pierced and can't wear heavy earrings yet.

诚恳.zh: 他态度很诚恳，我们就原谅了他。
诚恳.en: His attitude was sincere, so we forgave him.

多亏.zh: 多亏了这张地图，我们才没在山里迷路。
多亏.en: Thanks to this map, we didn't get lost in the mountains.

随手.zh: 用完的东西要随手放回原处。
随手.en: Put things back where they belong as soon as you've finished with them.

姥姥.zh: 妈妈说，姥姥做的饺子是世界上最好吃的。
姥姥.en: Mum says her mother's dumplings are the best in the world.

桔子.zh: 冬天坐在暖气旁边剥桔子吃，特别舒服。
桔子.en: Sitting by the radiator peeling tangerines in winter is really cosy.

丝绸.zh: 古代的商人通过丝绸之路把中国的茶叶带到了西方。
丝绸.en: Ancient merchants carried Chinese tea to the West along the Silk Road.

转告.zh: 他不在办公室，有什么事我可以帮您转告。
转告.en: He isn't in the office; I can pass on a message for you.

调皮.zh: 小猫很调皮，把桌上的杯子推到了地上。
调皮.en: The kitten was naughty and pushed the cup off the table onto the floor.

麦克风.zh: 主持人拿着麦克风走到了舞台中间。
麦克风.en: The host walked to the middle of the stage holding the microphone.

公元.zh: 秦始皇在公元前221年统一了中国。
公元.en: Qin Shi Huang unified China in 221 BC.

冷淡.zh: 这家店的服务员对顾客很冷淡，所以生意不好。
冷淡.en: The staff in this shop are cold towards customers, so business is poor.

游览.zh: 坐船游览长江三峡是很多游客的选择。
游览.en: Touring the Three Gorges of the Yangtze by boat is a popular choice for visitors.

抽象.zh: 这幅抽象画很多人都看不懂。
抽象.en: Many people can't make sense of this abstract painting.

悠久.zh: 端午节吃粽子是一个悠久的传统。
悠久.en: Eating zongzi at the Dragon Boat Festival is a long-standing tradition.

陆续.zh: 电影结束后，观众们陆续离开了电影院。
陆续.en: After the film ended, the audience left the cinema one after another.

试卷.zh: 考试快结束时，他又把试卷仔细检查了一遍。
试卷.en: Near the end of the exam, he carefully checked his paper once more.

讨价还价.zh: 她很会讨价还价，最后只花了一半的钱。
讨价还价.en: She's good at haggling and ended up paying only half.

责备.zh: 这件事不能只责备他一个人，大家都有责任。
责备.en: You can't blame him alone for this; everyone is responsible.

刻苦.zh: 运动员们每天刻苦训练，为了在比赛中取得好成绩。
刻苦.en: The athletes train hard every day in order to do well in competition.

单调.zh: 这幅画颜色太单调了，可以再加点儿绿色。
单调.en: The colours of this painting are too dull; you could add some green.

除夕.zh: 除夕夜十二点，外面响起了鞭炮声。
除夕.en: At midnight on Chinese New Year's Eve, firecrackers went off outside.

管子.zh: 他用一根塑料管子给花园里的花浇水。
管子.en: He watered the flowers in the garden with a plastic tube.

岛屿.zh: 这片海上分布着大大小小几百个岛屿。
岛屿.en: Hundreds of islands, large and small, are scattered across this sea.

小气.zh: 别那么小气，借我一支笔又不会怎么样。
小气.en: Don't be so stingy; lending me a pen won't hurt you.

池塘.zh: 夏天的晚上，池塘里的青蛙叫个不停。
池塘.en: On summer nights, the frogs in the pond croak non-stop.

再三.zh: 妈妈再三叮嘱我，到了学校要马上给家里打电话。
再三.en: Mum told me again and again to call home as soon as I got to school.

不耐烦.zh: 他问了好几遍同样的问题，老师也没有不耐烦。
不耐烦.en: He asked the same question several times, yet the teacher never grew impatient.

平方.zh: 这个公园占地五千平方米，里面还有一个湖。
平方.en: This park covers five thousand square metres and even has a lake.

果实.zh: 大家要珍惜来之不易的劳动果实。
果实.en: Everyone should cherish the hard-won fruits of their labour.

日历.zh: 墙上挂着一本日历，上面写着今天是星期五。
日历.en: A calendar hangs on the wall, showing that today is Friday.

往返.zh: 我买了一张北京到上海的往返机票。
往返.en: I bought a return plane ticket between Beijing and Shanghai.

灾害.zh: 今年的洪水灾害影响了很多农民的收成。
灾害.en: This year's flood disaster affected many farmers' harvests.

夏令营.zh: 这个科学夏令营让孩子们在山里观察星星。
夏令营.en: This science summer camp lets children observe the stars in the mountains.

内科.zh: 她是一位内科医生，在这家医院工作了十年。
内科.en: She's a doctor of internal medicine and has worked at this hospital for ten years.

轻视.zh: 这个病虽然不严重，但也不能轻视。
轻视.en: Although this illness isn't serious, it shouldn't be taken lightly.

一律.zh: 公司规定，迟到的员工一律扣钱。
一律.en: Company rules say that all late employees, without exception, lose pay.

样式.zh: 这双鞋的样式很简单，颜色也不错。
样式.en: The style of these shoes is simple, and the colour is nice too.

长辈.zh: 吃饭的时候，要等长辈先动筷子。
长辈.en: At meals, you should wait for your elders to pick up their chopsticks first.

疼爱.zh: 他是家里最小的孩子，全家人都很疼爱他。
疼爱.en: He's the youngest child, and the whole family dotes on him.

吃亏.zh: 他觉得自己学历低，找工作的时候很吃亏。
吃亏.en: He feels his low qualifications put him at a disadvantage when job hunting.

苗条.zh: 为了变得苗条，她每天晚上都不吃饭。
苗条.en: To get slim, she skips dinner every night.

淘气.zh: 弟弟小时候特别淘气，经常爬到树上去。
淘气.en: My little brother was very mischievous as a child and often climbed trees.

学问.zh: 做菜也是一门学问，火候很重要。
学问.en: Cooking is a body of knowledge too; controlling the heat is very important.

光盘.zh: 以前的电脑游戏都装在光盘里卖。
光盘.en: Computer games used to be sold on discs.

与其.zh: 与其每天抱怨工作，不如去找一份新工作。
与其.en: Rather than complaining about your job every day, you'd do better to find a new one.

鲜艳.zh: 春天到了，公园里开满了鲜艳的花朵。
鲜艳.en: Spring has arrived, and the park is full of brightly coloured flowers.

看不起.zh: 他因为家里穷，曾经被同学看不起。
看不起.en: Because his family was poor, he was once looked down on by his classmates.

竹子.zh: 这个村子周围长满了竹子，风景特别美。
竹子.en: The village is surrounded by bamboo, and the scenery is especially beautiful.

照常.zh: 春节期间，这家超市照常营业。
照常.en: During the Spring Festival, this supermarket is open as usual.

象棋.zh: 他从小就跟爸爸学下象棋，现在已经很厉害了。
象棋.en: He learned Chinese chess from his dad as a child and is now very good.

慌张.zh: 第一次见女朋友的父母，他显得有点儿慌张。
慌张.en: Meeting his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he seemed a bit flustered.

空闲.zh: 他工作很忙，几乎没有空闲时间陪孩子。
空闲.en: He's very busy at work and has almost no free time to spend with his children.

时差.zh: 北京和伦敦有七八个小时的时差。
时差.en: There's a time difference of seven or eight hours between Beijing and London.

能干.zh: 这个小姑娘真能干，才十岁就会做饭了。
能干.en: This little girl is really capable; she can cook at only ten.

中旬.zh: 这批货最晚下个月中旬就能到。
中旬.en: This shipment will arrive by the middle of next month at the latest.

湿润.zh: 这种面霜能让皮肤保持湿润。
湿润.en: This face cream keeps the skin moisturised.

风俗.zh: 端午节赛龙舟是中国南方的传统风俗。
风俗.en: Dragon boat racing at the Dragon Boat Festival is a traditional custom in southern China.

油炸.zh: 这道菜要先油炸，再放调料炒一下。
油炸.en: This dish is first deep-fried, then stir-fried with seasoning.

教材.zh: 这套教材配有录音和练习册，非常方便。
教材.en: This set of textbooks comes with recordings and workbooks, which is very convenient.

躲藏.zh: 那只受伤的小鸟躲藏在草丛里，一动也不动。
躲藏.en: The injured little bird hid in the grass, perfectly still.

开水.zh: 泡方便面要用开水，温水泡不开。
开水.en: Instant noodles need boiling water; warm water won't soften them.

馒头.zh: 早饭我吃了一个馒头，喝了一碗粥。
馒头.en: For breakfast I had a steamed bun and a bowl of porridge.

书架.zh: 他把看完的书都整齐地放回了书架上。
书架.en: He neatly put the books he had finished back on the bookshelf.

煤炭.zh: 以前，很多北方家庭冬天靠烧煤炭取暖。
煤炭.en: In the past, many northern families burned coal to keep warm in winter.

充电器.zh: 手机快没电了，你带充电器了吗？
充电器.en: My phone's almost out of battery—did you bring a charger?

发愁.zh: 妈妈每天都为做什么菜发愁。
发愁.en: Every day Mum frets about what to cook.

次要.zh: 对我来说，工资多少是次要的，我更看重发展机会。
次要.en: For me, the salary is secondary; I care more about opportunities to grow.

片面.zh: 只看一个人的成绩来判断他，是很片面的。
片面.en: Judging a person only by his grades is very one-sided.

本科.zh: 她本科毕业以后，又去国外读了硕士。
本科.en: After finishing her bachelor's degree, she went abroad to do a master's.

鞭炮.zh: 为了安全，很多城市已经禁止燃放鞭炮了。
鞭炮.en: For safety reasons, many cities have banned setting off firecrackers.

清淡.zh: 这家餐厅的菜味道很清淡，适合老人吃。
清淡.en: The food in this restaurant is light, which suits elderly people.

押金.zh: 借自行车要交两百元押金，还车时退给你。
押金.en: To borrow a bike you pay a 200-yuan deposit, which is refunded when you return it.

不见得.zh: 考试成绩好的学生，工作能力不见得就强。
不见得.en: Students with good exam results aren't necessarily good at their jobs.

孝顺.zh: 父母年纪大了，我们做子女的要孝顺他们。
孝顺.en: Our parents are getting old, and as their children we should be devoted to them.

经商.zh: 他家祖祖辈辈都在这条街上经商。
经商.en: His family has done business on this street for generations.

元旦.zh: 一月一日是元旦，是新的一年的第一天。
元旦.en: January the first is New Year's Day, the first day of the new year.

汇率.zh: 出国前最好先查一下当天的汇率。
汇率.en: Before going abroad, it's best to check that day's exchange rate.

鼠标.zh: 你用鼠标点一下右上角的那个按钮。
鼠标.en: Click the button in the top right corner with the mouse.

朗读.zh: 她在比赛中朗读了一首自己写的诗。
朗读.en: In the competition she read aloud a poem she had written herself.

急忙.zh: 看到天快下雨了，她急忙把阳台上的衣服收了进来。
急忙.en: Seeing that it was about to rain, she hurriedly brought in the clothes from the balcony.

结账.zh: 这家超市的自助结账机很方便，不用排队。
结账.en: This supermarket's self-checkout machines are convenient—no queuing needed.

胶水.zh: 信封没封好，你拿胶水再粘一下。
胶水.en: The envelope isn't sealed properly; stick it down again with some glue.

用功.zh: 考试快到了，大家都在图书馆用功读书。
用功.en: Exams are coming, and everyone is studying hard in the library.

打喷嚏.zh: 春天花粉多，我一出门就不停地打喷嚏。
打喷嚏.en: There's a lot of pollen in spring; as soon as I go out, I can't stop sneezing.

国庆节.zh: 国庆节期间，各大景点的游客特别多。
国庆节.en: During the National Day holiday, the major tourist sites are especially crowded.

省略.zh: 这句话的主语可以省略，意思还是很清楚。
省略.en: The subject of this sentence can be left out, and the meaning is still clear.

夹子.zh: 风太大了，晾衣服的时候要用夹子夹住。
夹子.en: It's very windy, so use clips to hold the clothes when you hang them out.

爱惜.zh: 这把小提琴是爷爷留下的，他一直很爱惜。
爱惜.en: This violin was left to him by his grandfather, and he has always treasured it.

近代.zh: 这座博物馆展示了中国近代工业的发展过程。
近代.en: This museum shows how Chinese industry developed in the modern era.

胡同.zh: 他从小在北京的胡同里长大，对那里很有感情。
胡同.en: He grew up in Beijing's hutongs and is very attached to them.

灰心.zh: 投了几十份简历都没有回音，他有点儿灰心了。
灰心.en: He sent out dozens of CVs without a reply and is starting to lose heart.

拐弯.zh: 车拐弯的时候要减速，注意行人。
拐弯.en: Slow down when turning a corner and watch out for pedestrians.

退步.zh: 好久不练，我的钢琴水平退步了不少。
退步.en: I haven't practised for ages, and my piano playing has slipped a lot.

梳子.zh: 这把木头梳子是奶奶年轻时用的。
梳子.en: This wooden comb is the one Grandma used when she was young.

人民币.zh: 在中国旅游，可以用人民币，也可以用手机支付。
人民币.en: When travelling in China, you can pay in renminbi or with your phone.

着凉.zh: 刚洗完澡别吹空调，容易着凉。
着凉.en: Don't sit in the air conditioning right after a shower—you can easily catch a chill.

胆小鬼.zh: 他晚上一个人不敢出门，大家都笑他是胆小鬼。
胆小鬼.en: He doesn't dare go out alone at night, and everyone laughs at him for being a coward.

华裔.zh: 这位华裔科学家的父母很早就移民到了加拿大。
华裔.en: This Chinese-descended scientist's parents emigrated to Canada long ago.

声调.zh: 普通话有四个声调，再加一个轻声。
声调.en: Mandarin has four tones, plus a neutral tone.

厘米.zh: 儿子这一年长高了五厘米，裤子都短了。
厘米.en: My son grew five centimetres this year, and his trousers are now too short.

文具.zh: 学校门口有一家小文具店，卖铅笔和本子。
文具.en: There's a small stationery shop by the school gate that sells pencils and notebooks.

日用品.zh: 搬进新家以后，我们去超市买了牙刷、毛巾等日用品。
日用品.en: After moving into our new home, we went to the supermarket for toothbrushes, towels and other daily necessities.

扇子.zh: 这把扇子上画着山水，是朋友从杭州带来的。
扇子.en: This fan is painted with a landscape; a friend brought it from Hangzhou.

成语.zh: “画蛇添足”是一个大家都很熟悉的成语。
成语.en: "Drawing legs on a snake" is an idiom everyone knows well.

归纳.zh: 学完这一课，请大家归纳一下这个语法的用法。
归纳.en: Now that we've finished this lesson, please sum up how this grammar point is used.

虚心.zh: 他虚心向老员工请教，很快就熟悉了工作。
虚心.en: He humbly asked the experienced staff for advice and soon got the hang of the job.

叉子.zh: 这个孩子还不会用筷子，只能用叉子吃面条。
叉子.en: This child can't use chopsticks yet and has to eat noodles with a fork.

粘贴.zh: 你可以把这段文字复制下来，粘贴到邮件里。
粘贴.en: You can copy this text and paste it into the email.

推辞.zh: 公司想让他当经理，他推辞说自己经验不够。
推辞.en: The company wanted him to be manager, but he declined, saying he lacked experience.

提纲.zh: 开会前，他先把要讲的内容写成了一个提纲。
提纲.en: Before the meeting, he wrote what he was going to say into an outline.

好客.zh: 主人非常好客，非要留我们吃晚饭。
好客.en: Our host was very hospitable and insisted that we stay for dinner.

挂号.zh: 这封信很重要，最好用挂号信寄出去。
挂号.en: This letter is important; it's best to send it by registered mail.

太极拳.zh: 他练了二十年太极拳，身体比年轻人还好。
太极拳.en: He has practised tai chi for twenty years and is healthier than many young people.

尺子.zh: 画直线的时候，最好用尺子帮忙。
尺子.en: When drawing a straight line, it's best to use a ruler.

标点.zh: 这句话少了一个标点，意思就完全变了。
标点.en: This sentence is missing a punctuation mark, and its meaning has completely changed.

劳驾.zh: 劳驾，您能帮我把箱子放到上面吗？
劳驾.en: Excuse me, could you help me put my suitcase up there?

干活儿.zh: 工人们在工地上干活儿，从早忙到晚。
干活儿.en: The workers are working on the building site, busy from morning till night.

连忙.zh: 听说妈妈生病了，他连忙买了回家的火车票。
连忙.en: Hearing that his mum was ill, he promptly bought a train ticket home.

冰激凌.zh: 这家店的冰激凌有二十多种口味。
冰激凌.en: This shop's ice cream comes in more than twenty flavours.

后背.zh: 天太热了，他的衬衫后背全湿了。
后背.en: It's so hot that the back of his shirt is soaked through.

名胜古迹.zh: 这本旅游书介绍了全国各地的名胜古迹。
名胜古迹.en: This travel guide introduces famous scenic spots and historic sites all over the country.

拼音.zh: 这本儿童读物的每个汉字上面都标了拼音。
拼音.en: Every character in this children's book has its pinyin marked above it.

模特.zh: 这家服装公司正在招聘身高一米七以上的模特。
模特.en: This clothing company is recruiting models who are over 1.7 metres tall.

使劲儿.zh: 我使劲儿喊了好几声，他都没听见。
使劲儿.en: I shouted with all my might several times, but he didn't hear.

系领带.zh: 他平时很少系领带，今天是因为要参加婚礼。
系领带.en: He rarely wears a tie, but today he's going to a wedding.
